title: Pashov C-02 (missing `_update` override in StrategyWrapper used as Morpho collateral) — live state shows value-bearing markets run patched wrappers; pre-patch wrappers survive only in dust markets and yield $0 to an unprivileged attacker
closed_reasons: The 4 value-bearing Stake DAO Morpho markets ($629,606 collateral, $540,792 borrowed, backed by the $1.008M curator vaults) use PATCHED StrategyWrappers: transfer/transferFrom gated to the lending protocol; claimLiquidation has `require(liquidator != LENDING_PROTOCOL && liquidator != address(this))` + hole-clamp; reward settle always advances rewardPerTokenPaid. Fork-verified: claimLiquidation(MORPHO,...) reverts.

`_update` is still not overridden in either generation (C-02 recommendation not followed), but the patched generation removes the attack surface by construction, so C-02 has no reachable impact on live value.

The pre-patch wrapper code (no guard, no clamp, settle-only-if-nonzero) IS live in 17 dust markets (~$0 collateral). claimLiquidation(MORPHO, victim, amt) executes there, but the unwrapped RewardVault shares are sent to Morpho, so the caller gains 0 RV shares (fork-verified). Effect is griefing/DoS, not theft.

No unprivileged value-extraction path found; the largest residual (an orphaned 233.74 CRV pot ≈ $85.47 on pre-patch wrapper 0x3B85...) is bounded and conditional (needs a dust deposit before an integral increase + real RewardVault capital + time).
key_facts: Audit: pashov/audits team/md/StakeDAO-security-review_2025-07-21.md, C-02 CRITICAL 'Checkpoints are almost always outdated due to missing _update override', Acknowledged; review commit 2fc6613..., fixes-review 07874f7...

DefiLlama stake-dao-curator = $1,007,814 (USDC 359,371 + FRXUSD 648,443); curator vaults: USDC v2 0x8EDCC305E633d29BFB383872e79401c506cE9E6f (359,574.94 USDC), frxUSD v2 owner 0xB0552b6860CE5C0202976Db056b5e3Cc4f9CC765

All wrappers deployed by EOA 0x794addd03889c2b96b16ad230e372b78964d9c76; wrapper owner() = address(0) (renounced); LENDING_PROTOCOL = Morpho Blue 0xBBBBBbbBBb9cC5e90e3b3Af64bdAF62C37EEFFCb; non-upgradeable
Fork reads @ block 26,255,442: W_FIX 0x6292... totalSupply = balanceOf(MORPHO) = 359,614.566...e18; W_OLD 0x7658... totalSupply 988.586...e18, balanceOf(MORPHO) = 0
Orphaned reward pot: pre-patch wrapper 0x3B855AA8CC56a3cBd5dBb5456F5A13Ce86AA0fe8 (stakedao-FrxMsUSD) holds 233,744,780,983,111,838,994 CRV at totalSupply = 1 wei (= $85.47 @ CRV $0.365743)
PoC 4/4 PASS: pre-patch missing-guard path executes but caller gains 0 RV shares; patched wrapper reverts (guard); legit off-track holder path settles fully; orphaned pot quantified
caveats: The audited repo stake-dao/contracts-monorepo is now private; stake-dao/lending-contracts-audit (commit da08e86, tree 5f4cb2dd) is the public current-main reference and matches the patched live bytecode. The literal 2025-07-21 audited commit could not be byte-diffed; deployed code is ground truth.
USD values are DefiLlama/Morpho-API snapshots at block 26,255,442 and move with the market; dust wrapper underlying (~$19) is a rough price-based estimate.
The orphaned-pot drain is reasoned from the source diff, not executed on-chain (it requires real-time Accountant integral growth).
Adjacent audit findings M-07/M-08/L-10 (Curve-LP oracle flash-loan manipulation) are out of C-02 scope and were not reduced to a live path here.
No mainnet transaction was signed or sent; all exploit mechanics ran on local forks.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live: the 4 value-bearing Stake DAO Morpho markets ($629.6k collateral / $540.8k borrowed / $1.008M curator vaults) run PATCHED StrategyWrappers (claimLiquidation liquidator-guard + hole-clamp + always-advance reward settle), so Pashov C-02 is unreachable there; the pre-patch wrapper code survives only in 17 dust markets (~$0 collateral) where the missing-guard claimLiquidation(MORPHO,...) path executes but pays the caller $0 (griefing only); residual ~$104 (≈$19 dust underlying + ≈$85 orphaned reward pot) is S/H-O, not attacker-reachable.
